newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: AIR NZ, Air Canada form alliance.
newsitem.headline: AIR NZ, Air Canada form alliance.

text.p: Air New Zealand Ltd said on Monday it had formed an alliance with Air Canada.
"The creation of a strategic parnership between Air New Zealand and Air Canada further strengthens the comprehensive alliances they have with United Airlines," Air New Zealand said in a statement.
Provisions in the agreement cover reciprocal participation in frequent flyer programmes, schedule co-ordination, through check-in, aircraft exchange and, subject to government approval, code sharing.
From November, the airlines' schedules and passenger services will be co-ordinated.
Last week, Air New Zealand and its half-owned partner Ansett Australian cemented an alliance with one of Asia's most successful carriers, Singapore Airlines.
Montreal-based Air Canada is Canada's largest airline flying 1,200 scheduled flights to over 120 destinations across Canada, the U.S., the Caribbean, Europe, the Middle East and Asia.
Earlier this month, Air New Zealand dropped its alliance with Canadian Airlines after Air NZ had established its alliance with United.
